description: This source file defines functions related to chart theming, including fetching CSS variables with fallbacks, color manipulation (hex to rgba), and a function to generate a chart theme object based on CSS variables and theme tokens. It also exports the getChartTheme function for external use.

methods.name: getCssVar(name, fallback)
methods.description: Reads a CSS variable from :root; if unavailable or an error occurs, returns the provided fallback value.

methods.name: withAlpha(hex, alpha, fallbackColor = "rgba(255,102,0,0.4)")
methods.description: Converts a hex color string to an rgba string with specified alpha, with fallback to a default color on failure.

methods.name: getChartTheme()
methods.description: Generates and returns a chart theme object using CSS variables with fallbacks to theme tokens.
